data: Original 23643 M15 and frozen FF trace; new 23735 export inventoried separately, not mixed into FF
full_window_gate: 12 consecutive existing M15 from recorded entry, no gap, no raw-day boundary including final close
excursion_cost: Hypothetical liquidation using frozen scenario Bid/Ask shift, adverse exit slippage and roundtrip commission. MFE=max(0,max net), MAE=max(0,-min net); not broker-real costs.
trade_lifetime: Resolved trace only; lower bounds use all bars strictly before terminal bar plus recorded exit net; upper envelopes also include terminal OHLC, whose extrema may occur after exit. Never label the envelope as exact trade MFE/MAE.
fixed_window: Counterfactual 12-bar post-entry behavior, may continue after original exit; never call this actual trade-lifetime MFE or a new strategy return.
intrabar: First SL and TP in same M15 = AMBIGUOUS unless observed open already crosses one threshold; no favorable ordering
normalization: Initial recorded entry-to-stop distance * lots * contract100. Not worst-case loss bound.
aggregation: All six candidates, both frozen costs, entry raw month and quarter, no hour/regime selection
unresolved: Separate counts; no invented close, swap, full net or annual equity
